caption: The drawing depicts a circular, flower-like object composed of alternating petal shapes in two colors: a deep red and a dark blue-black with grid patterns in light blue. Each petal is bordered by a thin yellow line. The red petals are solid, while the blue-black petals are filled with a fine cross-hatch or checkered pattern. The entire object is edged with purple triangular segments that create a spiky border. At the center of the circle is a small white circle surrounded by a blue octagon. In the lower right corner of the drawing, there is a partial view of the same object, showing its edge and a few petals in red, green, yellow, and blue sections. The background is a plain, light beige color with no additional objects or decorations.
title: Head Pad
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
